verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs describe an official Model Context Protocol server that lets users work with Adyen in natural language from their chosen LLM client, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. That is direct evidence the product ships the capability. However, the pack gives no detail on how an agent actually connects (setup, transport, auth), which tools the server exposes, or how it relates to the Agentic Commerce flows, so the connection part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented connection and setup steps (install, transport, authentication), the list of exposed MCP tools and their scope relative to Agentic Commerce, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
